name: video-chef
description: Professional video development with live, safety-gated Premiere sequence intelligence from story lock through editorial, sound, graphics, finishing, QC, and delivery.

interface.longDescription: A modular video-production system for story development, complete asset inventory, local word-timed transcription, scene and frame inspection, evidence-backed selects, live read-only Premiere sequence intelligence, guarded transcript-to-rough-cut planning, editorial construction, audio post, accessible captions, motion graphics, color and finishing, Adobe automation, deterministic QC, and verified delivery. It preserves original media, editable project lineage, rights provenance, and human creative approval.

Analyze this footage and build evidence-backed selects.

QC this cut for picture, sound, captions, and delivery.
